name: General Code Review Checklist
description: A lightweight checklist for consistent code reviews: readability, tests, and security.
author: community

rule.content:
## General Code Review Checklist

- Readability: naming, structure, and comments.
- Tests: new behavior has tests; existing tests still pass.
- Security: no sensitive data in logs or config; inputs validated.
- Dependencies: only needed deps; no known vulnerable versions.
